notes.title: Bullet Candy Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Bullet Candy have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Bullet Candy
  • Fixed a bug that could cause enemies to behave ‘strangely’ at high resolutions
  • Fixed a bug that was causing the game to run extremely slowly at high resolutions. It still looks best at 800x600 though

notes.title: Bullet Candy Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Bullet Candy have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Bullet Candy
  • Fixed mouse cursor not being displayed in menus on some ATI cards (added a cursor image)
  • Added a games played counter for the Hardcore achievement.
  • Fixed a bug that made the speed and orbit radius of some enemies (such as those on level 2) to be too fast and to wide.

tags.feature: • Added a games played counter for the Hardcore achievement.
